content: The medication should be stored at a temperature range of 20°C to 25°C. There is limited information available in the drug label regarding patient counseling for Ampicillin-Sulbactam. The interaction between alcohol and the combination of ampicillin sodium and sulbactam sodium has not been established. It is recommended to consult your doctor about the potential effects of consuming alcohol while taking this medication. The brand name for this medication is AMPICILLIN AND SULBACTAM®. There is limited information provided in the drug label regarding look-alike drug names for Ampicillin-Sulbactam.
